projectDescription: A web-based BPMN 2.0 process modeling tool inspired by Bizagi Modeler, featuring real-time collaboration, cloud persistence via Supabase, and full import/export interoperability with Bizagi, Camunda, and any OMG-standard BPMN tool.
keyFeatures: BPMN 2.0 full standard canvas with bpmn-js v18
Real-time collaboration via Supabase Realtime + Yjs CRDT
Bizagi-style palette with grouped element variants
Projects and diagram organization with trash/restore
Role-based access: owner, editor, viewer per diagram or project
Invite collaborators by email or shareable link
Dark and light theme with theme-aware SVG export
Optimistic concurrency control (CAS) on diagram saves
Keyboard shortcuts, undo/redo, multi-select, lasso selection
Validation panel with BPMN business-rule checking
publicApiSurface: IDiagramRepository: getAll, getById, save, delete, restore, purge, setDiagramName, setDiagramProject
IDiagramRepository: getProjects, saveProject, deleteProject, restoreProject, purgeProject, getTrash, purgeAll
IDiagramRepository: getFolders, saveFolder, deleteFolder, getPreferences, savePreferences
useExport: ExportFormat (bpmn | png | svg | pdf | bpm), PngScale (1|2|3), PdfOrientation, ExportTheme
useBpmnModeler: hook wrapping bpmn-js modeler instance
useCollab: hook for real-time collaborative session
useComments: hook for threaded comment management
YjsBpmnBinding: CRDT binding between Y.Doc and bpmn-js canvas
BPMN_ELEMENTS: BpmnElementDef[] catalog (35 elements across 5 categories)
Supabase migrations: 18 migration files (init → image library realtime)
DiagramConflictError: thrown on CAS save conflict
UserPreferences: language, theme, gridEnabled, gridSize, snapToGrid, autoSaveInterval, paletteMode, showComments, diagramSort
